body:
I weighed 135 lbs, the time I started smoking it. I slowly gained a tolerance, eventually I started shooting it. By the time I went to jail, I weighed 89 lbs. All because of meth. I weighed 110 when I started shooting it, and quickly lost a ton of weight I didnt have to lose to begin with, and weighed 89 lbs.
I am now clean from methamphetamine, yet the come down is a bitch, and the addiction is hard to battle. I wish you all the best of luck...
[Reported Dose: 40 ccs 6x a day]
